content.value_statement: Flutter teams need sound architecture and platform guidance. This skill helps plan, build, test, and optimize apps across Flutter targets.
actual_capabilities: Recommends Flutter architecture patterns such as Clean Architecture, MVVM, MVP, MVI, repository layers, and dependency injection.
Guides state management choices across Riverpod, Bloc, Cubit, GetX, Provider, Stacked, MobX, Redux, and custom approaches.
Helps design widgets, animations, responsive layouts, adaptive interfaces, themes, and platform-specific UI behavior.
Plans testing strategies for unit, widget, golden, integration, performance, accessibility, and CI workflows.
Advises performance optimization for rebuilds, rendering, memory, lists, images, isolates, bundle size, and target frame rates.
Covers platform integration for iOS, Android, web, desktop, embedded targets, native plugins, and platform channels.
limitations: It does not execute Flutter builds, tests, or deployments by itself.
Native integrations still require project-specific iOS, Android, web, desktop, or embedded implementation work.
Performance advice must be verified with profiling on real devices and realistic workloads.
Current platform rules and app store requirements should be checked against official documentation.

use_cases.title: Plan a Flutter Architecture
use_cases.description: Design a scalable structure with layers, modules, state management, data access, and testing boundaries before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Implement Cross-Platform Features
use_cases.description: Create UI, state flows, platform channels, responsive layouts, and native integrations for multiple Flutter targets.

use_cases.title: Improve Quality and Release Readiness
use_cases.description: Build testing, profiling, accessibility, CI, deployment, and store release plans for production Flutter apps.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Project Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning a new Flutter app
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose a Flutter structure for [platforms] with team size [team size] and features [features]. Explain modules, folders, state, and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Select State Management
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a state management approach for my Flutter app. Compare Riverpod, Bloc, Provider, and GetX for [app complexity], [team experience], and [testing needs].

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a User Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Flutter screen goal and propose an implementation plan for performance, accessibility, responsive layout, loading states, and error handling: [screen description].

prompt_templates.title: Design Production Delivery
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced team preparing a multi-platform release
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production plan for a Flutter app targeting [platforms]. Include architecture, platform channels, testing, CI, signing, deployment, monitoring, and rollback strategy.

output_examples.input: Plan a Flutter app with offline data sync and Riverpod.
output: Recommends a feature-first structure with domain, data, and presentation layers.
Uses Riverpod providers for repositories, use cases, and screen state.
Adds conflict resolution, retry behavior, integration tests, and sync status UI.

output_examples.input: Improve a slow Flutter list screen.
output: Identifies rebuild hotspots, image loading costs, list virtualization needs, and expensive synchronous work.
Suggests const widgets, keys, Slivers, caching, isolates, and profiling with Flutter DevTools.
Defines before-and-after metrics for frame time, memory, and user-perceived latency.

output_examples.input: Prepare a Flutter app for iOS and Android release.
output: Outlines signing, flavors, environment configuration, store assets, crash reporting, and privacy checks.
Adds unit, widget, integration, accessibility, and smoke tests to the release checklist.
Recommends staged rollout monitoring and rollback criteria.

best_practices: Provide target platforms, Flutter version, Dart version, app constraints, and current architecture when asking for guidance.
Ask for testing, accessibility, performance, and error handling plans with every major feature design.
Validate recommendations with Flutter tools, official documentation, device testing, and code review.
anti_patterns: Do not request a full production app without clear requirements, platform targets, data needs, and release constraints.
Do not skip accessibility, loading states, error states, and performance measurement until the end of development.
Do not treat native integrations or store release steps as automatic across every project and platform.

faq.question: What Flutter topics does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers architecture, Dart 3, widgets, state management, animations, testing, performance, deployment, security, and platform integration.

faq.question: Can it help choose a state management library?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare Riverpod, Bloc, Provider, GetX, and other options against app complexity and team needs.

faq.question: Does it generate complete Flutter projects?
faq.answer: It can provide plans and implementation guidance, but project setup, validation, and integration remain your responsibility.

faq.question: Can it support Flutter web and desktop apps?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes responsive design, web optimization, desktop features, and multi-platform trade-off guidance.

faq.question: How should I use it for performance work?
faq.answer: Share the screen, symptoms, target devices, metrics, and profiling results so it can suggest focused optimization steps.

faq.question: Is it compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
